name: The University of British Columbia (Vancouver campus)

programs.name: Computer Science BSc (admitted to the Faculty of Science)
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. UBC says the grades needed differ by degree and year; in past years a B average (mainly A and B grades) on your country's grading scale was required. General: at least three academic A Levels or six AS Levels, standing in six academic subject areas (GCSE, AS, A Level) including English, minimum grade C in English Literature or Language.
programs.ib_offer: No IB points total published. Completed IB Diploma including at least three Higher Level courses. Science needs IB Math Analysis and Approaches SL or HL, or Applications and Interpretations HL (AI SL is not acceptable), and one of IB Biology, Chemistry or Physics.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: graduation from a US regionally accredited school; three years of math to junior level; B- in junior-level English; SAT or ACT optional (applicants who do not submit scores are not disadvantaged); AP courses completed as part of the high school curriculum may be used to meet requirements. Science (Computer Science BSc): Pre-Calculus (AP or high school Calculus recommended for a BSc), one year of Chemistry, one year of Physics (Physics may be waived with grades of A in Pre-Calculus Math and AP Chemistry).
programs.required_subjects: Faculty of Science. IB: Math AA SL/HL or AI HL, plus one of Biology/Chemistry/Physics, plus Grade 11-equivalent Chemistry and Physics (Physics may be waived with 5s in IB Chemistry and IB Math). A Level: Math (A or AS), GCSE Chemistry, GCSE Physics (Physics may be waived with A grades in A-Level Math and Chemistry). US: Pre-Calculus, Chemistry, Physics.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-120 scale: 90 overall with Reading 22, Listening 22, Writing 21, Speaking 21. TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale: 4.5 overall with Reading 4.5, Listening 5, Writing 4.5, Speaking 4. Scores must come from a single sitting.
programs.english_note: UBC English Language Admission Standard (ELAS): minimum scores are per part in a single sitting; many applicants meet it without a test (for example four or more consecutive years of full-time education in English).
programs.notes: Admission is to the Faculty of Science (Bachelor of Science), Vancouver campus; the program page lists an optional Honours and optional Co-op. Fee: 2026/27 international tuition, first-year full course load (30 credits at $1,769.40 per credit = $53,082.00) from https://students.ubc.ca/finances/tuition-fees/undergraduate-tuition-fees/ ; the 2027/28 amount is not yet published (UBC says increases for students who start in 2026/27 are capped at 3% a year). A Personal Profile is part of the online application for most degrees (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/how-to-apply/personal-profile/). Deadlines (Fall 2027 entry): final application 15 Jan 2027; international applicants who also want the International Scholars awards must apply by 15 Nov 2026 (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/dates-deadlines/). Admission requirements by country and curriculum (US, UK/A-level, IB) are loaded from the selector on https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-high-schools/ and https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-baccalaureate/ ; AP route: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/advanced-placement/ (AP exam grade 4 or better earns first-year credit). English tests: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/english-language-competency/. A separate Computer Science BA exists in the Faculty of Arts and is not covered here.

programs.name: Economics BA (Faculty of Arts, Vancouver School of Economics)
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. UBC says the grades needed differ by degree and year; in past years a B average (mainly A and B grades) on your country's grading scale was required. General: at least three academic A Levels or six AS Levels, standing in six academic subject areas (GCSE, AS, A Level) including English, minimum grade C in English Literature or Language.
programs.ib_offer: No IB points total published. Completed IB Diploma including at least three Higher Level courses. UBC states that IB Math Applications and Interpretations SL (or Math Studies) does not satisfy the math requirement for the Vancouver School of Economics.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: graduation from a US regionally accredited school; three years of math to junior level; B- in junior-level English; SAT or ACT optional (applicants who do not submit scores are not disadvantaged); AP courses completed as part of the high school curriculum may be used to meet requirements. Arts degree-specific requirement: no specific courses beyond those needed for general admission.
programs.required_subjects: Faculty of Arts: no specific courses required beyond general admission. IB: Math Applications and Interpretations SL / Math Studies do not satisfy the math requirement for the Vancouver School of Economics.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-120 scale: 90 overall with Reading 22, Listening 22, Writing 21, Speaking 21. TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale: 4.5 overall with Reading 4.5, Listening 5, Writing 4.5, Speaking 4. Scores must come from a single sitting.
programs.english_note: UBC English Language Admission Standard (ELAS): minimum scores are per part in a single sitting; many applicants meet it without a test (for example four or more consecutive years of full-time education in English).
programs.notes: Admission is to the Faculty of Arts (Bachelor of Arts), Vancouver campus; the program page lists Minor, Major and Honours options and optional Co-op. A separate Bachelor of International Economics exists and is not covered here. Fee: 2026/27 international tuition for Arts, first-year full course load (30 credits at $1,717.68 per credit = $51,530.40) from https://students.ubc.ca/finances/tuition-fees/undergraduate-tuition-fees/ ; the 2027/28 amount is not yet published. A Personal Profile is part of the online application for most degrees (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/how-to-apply/personal-profile/). Deadlines (Fall 2027 entry): final application 15 Jan 2027; international applicants who also want the International Scholars awards must apply by 15 Nov 2026 (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/dates-deadlines/). Requirements by curriculum: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-high-schools/ (US and UK selections) and https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-baccalaureate/ ; AP: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/advanced-placement/ .

programs.name: Applied Science (Engineering) BASc, common first year
programs.a_level_offer: No fixed grade offer published. UBC says the grades needed differ by degree and year; in past years a B average (mainly A and B grades) on your country's grading scale was required. Applied Science needs A Level Math, A Level Chemistry or Physics, and GCSE Chemistry and Physics; preference is given to applicants presenting both A Level Chemistry and A Level Physics.
programs.ib_offer: No IB points total published. Completed IB Diploma including at least three Higher Level courses. Applied Science needs IB Math Analysis and Approaches SL or HL, or Applications and Interpretations HL (AI SL is not acceptable), plus IB Chemistry and IB Physics; academically strong candidates missing either may be evaluated case by case.
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: graduation from a US regionally accredited school; three years of math to junior level; B- in junior-level English; SAT or ACT optional (applicants who do not submit scores are not disadvantaged); AP courses completed as part of the high school curriculum may be used to meet requirements. Applied Science (Engineering): Pre-Calculus, AP Chemistry (or two full years of Chemistry), AP Physics 2 or C; academically strong candidates missing either AP Chemistry or AP Physics may be evaluated case by case.
programs.required_subjects: Math (Pre-Calculus / IB Math AA or AI HL / A Level Math), Chemistry and Physics (AP Chemistry or two years; AP Physics 2 or C; IB Chemistry and Physics; GCSE Chemistry and Physics).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 1-120 scale: 90 overall with Reading 22, Listening 22, Writing 21, Speaking 21. TOEFL iBT 1-6 scale: 4.5 overall with Reading 4.5, Listening 5, Writing 4.5, Speaking 4. Scores must come from a single sitting.
programs.english_note: UBC English Language Admission Standard (ELAS): minimum scores are per part in a single sitting; many applicants meet it without a test (for example four or more consecutive years of full-time education in English).
programs.notes: UBC's engineering page describes a foundational first year followed by choosing one of the BASc engineering programs (14 programs on two campuses); this entry is the Applied Science (Engineering) first-year admission, Vancouver campus. The 4-year length is as stated on the Vancouver Mechanical Engineering page (https://you.ubc.ca/programs/mechanical-engineering-vancouver/). Fee: 2026/27 international tuition for Applied Science - Engineering, first-year full course load (37 credits at $1,789.18 per credit = $66,199.66, shown here rounded to $66,200) from https://students.ubc.ca/finances/tuition-fees/undergraduate-tuition-fees/ ; the 2027/28 amount is not yet published. A Personal Profile is part of the online application for most degrees (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/how-to-apply/personal-profile/). Deadlines (Fall 2027 entry): final application 15 Jan 2027; international applicants who also want the International Scholars awards must apply by 15 Nov 2026 (https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/dates-deadlines/). Requirements by curriculum: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-high-schools/ (US and UK selections, degree 'Applied Science (Engineering)') and https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/international-baccalaureate/ ; AP: https://you.ubc.ca/applying-ubc/requirements/advanced-placement/ .
